style: Dark cinematic synth-pop and trip-hop, 92 BPM, D minor, smoky intimate female vocal, deep sub bass, dusty breakbeat drums, detuned analog pads, glassy arpeggios, wide dramatic chorus, detailed modern production
lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights tremble on the rain
Your reflection leaves the train
Every signal bends and breaks
I can feel the city wake

[Chorus]
Pull me through the static tonight
Hold the frequency just right
If the skyline disappears
I will find you through the noise
